description: Return the upcoming compliance obligations for an Agent Company, computed from its formation date. NEVIS companies: registered-agent + government renewal (with fee and USDC payment address), beneficial-owner update rules, and — if a Wyoming USD subsidiary was elected — the Wyoming annual report and US IRS Form 5472. WYOMING STANDALONE companies ($299 tier): the WY annual report (first day of the anniversary month, $60 minimum license tax), registered-agent renewal, and the federal filing that applies (Form 5472 + pro-forma 1120 for a foreign-owned single-member LLC; Form 1065 for multi-member). Use this to keep the entity in good standing year over year.
name: get_compliance_calendar
